learning_outcomes.text: To give students the capacity to project and to analyze a digital radio relay link, giving special emphasis on the quality of service parameters, link performance, capacity and cost.
To familiarize and give capacity to project other telecommunication systems, namely those using satellites.

syllabus_topics: Propagation elements considering both plain and spherical Earth
Fading; theoretical and empirical models; reflections; diversity; passive and active repeaters
Digital links; quality of service and ITU-R related recommendations; project guidelines
Implementation of a complete engineering project of a Radio Relay Link from specifications, observing all ITU-R, as well as economic and sustainability recommendations.
Basic principles of satellite communications: geostationary orbits, Equivalent Isotropic Radiated Power (EIRP), receiver sensitivity, quality of service and project criteria.

assessment_methods.method: Written Test at the end of the semester

assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated as 60% from the project evaluation and 40% from the written test. A minimum score of 9.5/20 is required on the written test. The realization of the Radio Relay Link project is compulsory.
